lines.speaker: narrator
lines.en: The old well. This is where Granny Bai first hid the egg. The fog has reached the village.

lines.speaker: granny_bai
lines.en: You're back. The egg — it's shaking!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.en: Crack... crack... POP! A tiny golden dragon tumbles out.

lines.speaker: granny_bai
lines.en: A golden dragon. The last free one, if I am right. The Demon King is hunting him.

lines.speaker: granny_bai
lines.en: If he stays, the village is next. I am too old to walk the road.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.en: What do you say to him?

lines.speaker: xiaolong
lines.en: (He spins in a circle and hugs your leg.)

lines.speaker: xiaolong
lines.en: (He tilts his head, waiting... then hugs your leg anyway.)

lines.speaker: granny_bai
lines.en: When someone is kind, we say {C007}. Take him. Follow the old Bell Road. Ring the Bell before home goes silent.

lines.speaker: granny_bai
lines.en: His name is 小龙. Little Dragon. The King still wears a fog crown. Off you go.
